Title: NETMESSAGE:Unfortunately, the teleporter needs an energy-crystal. There should be one in the complex ahead.
Translation: 不幸的是，传送器需要一颗能量水晶。前方建筑群里应该有一颗。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The base is about to be attacked. We have to move there fast.
Translation: 基地即将遭到攻击。我们必须尽快赶到那里。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Be careful, there are aliens all over the complex!
Translation: 小心，建筑群里到处都是外星人！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Someone has picked up the crystal. Place it into the container.
Translation: 有人捡起了水晶。把它放进容器里。
